verses.v0:
[Verse]
Morning light upon the river
Carry me where the willows grow
Every step a quiet whisper
Every breath a song I know
verses.v1:
[Verse]
Silver rain across the window
Gentle voices call my name
Underneath the yellow lantern
Nothing ever stays the same
verses.v2:
[Verse]
Follow me along the harbor
Sailing boats are drifting by
Seven seagulls in the morning
Painting circles in the sky
verses.v3:
[Verse]
Remember all the summer evenings
Dancing slowly by the fire
Every story that we started
Carried higher, ever higher
